name: Jehoiada
whenBasis: The reign as the Reign tab dates it, from Thiele's reconstruction of the kings' stated lengths and synchronisms; the other readings there differ by a few years.
summary: Priest in Jerusalem, husband of Jehosheba, King Jehoram's daughter, who hid the infant Joash. In the seventh year of Athaliah's rule he gathered the commanders and guards, crowned Joash in the temple, and had Athaliah executed. He made a covenant between the LORD, the king and the people, had the temple of Baal torn down, and guided Joash for the rest of his life. He died at 130 and was buried among the kings.
body: He sets the guards at the gates and around the king, and arms the captains with David's own spears and shields kept in the temple. Chronicles says he was buried in the City of David with the kings, because he had done good in Israel for God and his house. After his death Joash turns away and has his son Zechariah stoned.
